name: 垃圾桶清理
desc: 彻底删除的二次确认（标题「彻底删除这一条？」、取消不删、确认才删）、清空垃圾桶（空时禁用、确认框带条数、取消 / 确认）、刷新后删除结果落盘；入垃圾桶的 5 秒等待用宿主数值 wait 步骤

steps.eval: if (typeof T === 'undefined') { window.T = {}; } T.wipe = async () => { const { getStorage } = await import('/nos/storage/main.js'); const s = getStorage('conjure-todo-app'); const K = '__todo_test_backup_v1'; if (localStorage.getItem('__todo_test_dirty') === '1') { const o = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(K) || 'null'); if (o) { if (o.todos) await s.setItem('todos', o.todos); if (o.groups) await s.setItem('groups', o.groups); if (o.ui) await s.setItem('ui', o.ui); } } const snap = { todos: await s.getItem('todos'), groups: await s.getItem('groups'), ui: await s.getItem('ui') }; localStorage.setItem(K, JSON.stringify(snap)); localStorage.setItem('__todo_test_dirty', '1'); await s.removeItem('todos'); await s.removeItem('groups'); await s.removeItem('ui'); sessionStorage.removeItem('todo-ui-state'); return 'wiped, backup todos=' + (snap.todos ? snap.todos.length : 0); }; return await T.wipe();

if (typeof T === 'undefined') { window.T = {}; } T.q = (s) => { const p = document.querySelector('o-page'); const r = p && p.shadowRoot; return r ? Array.from(r.querySelectorAll(s)) : []; }; T.ready = async (sel, ms) => { const n = Math.ceil((ms || 3000) / 100); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { if (T.q(sel).length) return true; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } throw new Error('页面就绪超时，找不到 ' + sel); }; T.tx = (el) => el.textContent.trim(); T.click = (el) => { if (!el) throw new Error('元素不存在'); const b = el.shadowRoot && el.shadowRoot.querySelector('button'); (b || el).click(); return true; }; T.byText = (sel, t) => T.q(sel).find((e) => T.tx(e) === t) || null; T.btn = (t) => T.click(T.byText('st-button', t)); T.dlg = () => T.q('st-dialog').find((d) => d.hasAttribute('open')) || null; T.dlgBtn = (t) => { const d = T.dlg(); if (!d) throw new Error('当前没有打开的弹窗'); return T.click(Array.from(d.querySelectorAll('st-button')).find((b) => T.tx(b) === t)); }; T.dlgHead = () => T.tx(T.dlg().querySelector('[slot=headline]')); T.wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms || 300)); T.NL = String.fromCharCode(10); T.setVal = (el, v) => { if (!el) throw new Error('输入元素不存在'); el.value = v; el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return true; }; T.items = () => T.q('.item'); T.need = (t) => { const i = T.items().find((x) => T.tx(x.querySelector('.text')) === t); if (!i) throw new Error('找不到任务：' + t); return i; }; T.addTask = async (title, desc) => { T.btn('添加任务'); await T.wait(350); const d = T.dlg(); if (!d) throw new Error('添加弹窗未打开'); T.setVal(d.querySelector('.dialog-field'), desc ? title + T.NL + desc : title); await T.wait(250); T.dlgBtn('添加'); await T.wait(400); return true; }; T.del = (t) => T.click(Array.from(T.need(t).querySelectorAll('.item-actions st-icon-button'))[1]); T.view = (t) => T.click(T.q('st-button-group st-button').find((b) => T.tx(b).indexOf(t) === 0)); T.purge = (t) => T.click(T.need(t).querySelector('st-icon-button')); T.emptyText = () => T.tx(document.querySelector('o-page').shadowRoot.querySelector('.empty')); return 'helpers ready';
await T.ready('.add-group-btn'); await T.addTask('任务A', ''); T.del('任务A'); await T.wait(400); if (T.need('任务A').className.indexOf('pending') === -1) throw new Error('「任务A」应进入倒计时'); return 'deleted';
await T.ready('.shell'); T.view('垃圾桶'); await T.wait(450); if (T.items().length !== 1) throw new Error('垃圾桶应有 1 条，实际 ' + T.items().length); return 'ok';

T.purge('任务A'); await T.wait(450); const d = T.dlg(); if (!d) throw new Error('彻底删除应弹二次确认'); if (T.dlgHead() !== '彻底删除这一条？') throw new Error('确认框标题不正确：' + T.dlgHead()); if (d.textContent.indexOf('无法还原') === -1) throw new Error('确认框应提示无法还原'); T.dlgBtn('取消'); await T.wait(450); if (T.dlg()) throw new Error('点「取消」应关闭确认框'); if (T.items().length !== 1) throw new Error('取消后条目不应被删除'); return 'ok';

T.purge('任务A'); await T.wait(450); T.dlgBtn('确认'); await T.wait(550); if (T.items().length !== 0) throw new Error('确认后条目应被彻底删除'); if (T.emptyText().indexOf('垃圾桶是空的') === -1) throw new Error('应显示垃圾桶空状态：' + T.emptyText()); if (!T.byText('st-button', '清空垃圾桶').hasAttribute('disabled')) throw new Error('垃圾桶为空时「清空垃圾桶」应禁用'); return 'ok';

T.view('全部'); await T.wait(350); await T.addTask('甲', ''); await T.addTask('乙', ''); T.del('甲'); T.del('乙'); await T.wait(400); if (T.need('甲').className.indexOf('pending') === -1 || T.need('乙').className.indexOf('pending') === -1) throw new Error('两条都应进入倒计时'); return 'deleted';

await T.ready('.shell'); T.view('垃圾桶'); await T.wait(450); if (T.items().length !== 2) throw new Error('垃圾桶应有 2 条，实际 ' + T.items().length); T.btn('清空垃圾桶'); await T.wait(450); const d = T.dlg(); if (!d) throw new Error('清空垃圾桶应弹二次确认'); if (T.dlgHead() !== '清空垃圾桶？') throw new Error('确认框标题不正确：' + T.dlgHead()); if (d.textContent.indexOf('2 项') === -1) throw new Error('确认框应显示条数：' + d.textContent); T.dlgBtn('取消'); await T.wait(450); if (T.items().length !== 2) throw new Error('取消后垃圾桶条目应保留'); return 'ok';

T.btn('清空垃圾桶'); await T.wait(450); T.dlgBtn('确认'); await T.wait(550); if (T.items().length !== 0) throw new Error('确认后垃圾桶应被清空'); if (!T.byText('st-button', '清空垃圾桶').hasAttribute('disabled')) throw new Error('清空后按钮应禁用'); T.view('全部'); await T.wait(450); if (T.items().length !== 0) throw new Error('列表不应有残留条目，实际 ' + T.items().length); return 'ok';

let root = null; for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) { const p = document.querySelector('o-page'); root = p && p.shadowRoot; if (root && root.querySelector('.shell')) break; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } if (!root || !root.querySelector('.shell')) throw new Error('刷新后页面未就绪'); const items = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('.item')); if (items.length !== 0) throw new Error('刷新后彻底删除应已落盘，实际仍有 ' + items.length + ' 条'); return 'ok';

const { getStorage } = await import('/nos/storage/main.js'); const s = getStorage('conjure-todo-app'); const o = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('__todo_test_backup_v1') || 'null'); if (o) { if (o.todos) await s.setItem('todos', o.todos); if (o.groups) await s.setItem('groups', o.groups); if (o.ui) await s.setItem('ui', o.ui); } localStorage.removeItem('__todo_test_dirty'); sessionStorage.removeItem('todo-ui-state'); return 'restored';
